tree..knowledge/records/k3v9q2x7m1ab-producti:
---
knowledge: 1
id: 'k3v9q2x7m1ab'
kind: 'decision'
title: 'Production API runs at least two replicas'
applies_to: ['charts/api/**', 'envs/prod/**']
checks:
  - config_key: 'infra/prod/*.tf#resource.aws_db_instance.prod.multi_az'
    must: '== true'
  - config_key: 'infra/prod/*.tf#resource.aws_security_group.web.ingress[from_port=443].to_port'
    must: '== 443'
  - config_key: 'infra/prod/*.tf#terraform.required_version'
    assumes: 'exist'
  - config_key: 'apps/api/jobs.yaml#[kind=Job,metadata.name=api-migrate].metadata.annotations."argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave"'
    must: '== -1'
  - config_key: 'Cargo.lock#package[name=sqlx].version'
    assumes: '>= 0.8'
---
A single replica took the API down for 11 minutes on 2026-09-02 during a node drain:
the pod disruption budget cannot protect one pod. Two replicas with the PDB at
`minAvailable: 1` survive a drain. Cost was reviewed and accepted; a cost change goes
through a new decision that supersedes this one.
